summary: Two Codex user-journey tests fail on the branch with 'TypeError: _stub_restore_pipeline_gate() got an unexpected keyword argument research_required'. park_session.py now calls the stub with research_required and research_evidence kwargs but the test stubs were not updated to accept them. Affects test_welcome_surfaces_saved_human_gate_replay_target_after_resume and test_welcome_surfaces_promoted_revision_without_stale_human_gate_text.
evidence: Running python3 -m pytest tests/test_codex_user_journeys.py::test_welcome_surfaces_saved_human_gate_replay_target_after_resume tests/test_codex_user_journeys.py::test_welcome_surfaces_promoted_revision_without_stale_human_gate_text produces 2 failures. The mismatch is between _stub_restore_pipeline_gate in the test and the call site in park_session.py line 638.
recommended_action: Update _stub_restore_pipeline_gate in test_codex_user_journeys.py to accept **kwargs or the explicit research_required / research_evidence keyword arguments that park_session.py now passes.

summary: The five bounded-replay fields added to stage-summary.schema.yaml (replay_iteration, replay_target_stage, finding_class, threshold_limit, lineage_artifacts) are each independently optional with no schema-level co-presence enforcement. The subagent-router SKILL.md says to include all of them when the stage is part of a bounded-replay loop, but a subagent could emit replay_iteration without threshold_limit and pass schema validation. Consumers relying on these fields for replay routing may receive incomplete metadata without a validation error.
evidence: pipelines/stage-summary.schema.yaml has no allOf/if-then guard requiring that the presence of replay_iteration implies the presence of threshold_limit, replay_target_stage, and finding_class. skills/subagent-router/SKILL.md says include all five fields together.
recommended_action: Add a schema-level allOf / if-then rule: if replay_iteration is present, then require replay_target_stage, finding_class, and threshold_limit. Alternatively document explicitly that partial presence is valid and consumers must handle missing fields gracefully.

summary: The .codex/agents/orchestrator.toml file is missing the explicit deliver_full_s2_architect fail-closed spawn mandate that was added to .claude/commands/deliver-full.md in this PR. All other platform mirrors (Copilot prompt, Gemini TOML, OpenCode command) have the rule: 'Governed Stage 2 is a fresh-context architect stage. Spawn deliver_full_s2_architect next or fail closed before any inline architecture brief is produced.' The Codex orchestrator only mentions the run-ledger fail-closed run-queue rewrite rule (line 231) but not the Stage 2 spawn-or-fail-closed rule. Since .codex/agents/orchestrator.toml is a source file (not a deploy target), azoth-deploy.py does not propagate this.
evidence: grep deliver_full_s2_architect .codex/agents/orchestrator.toml returns no results. The same pattern is present in .claude/commands/deliver-full.md, .github/prompts/deliver-full.prompt.md, .gemini/commands/deliver-full.toml, .opencode/commands/deliver-full.md.
recommended_action: Add the deliver_full_s2_architect fail-closed spawn rule to .codex/agents/orchestrator.toml under the Pipeline Composition section, matching the language used in the other platform mirrors.

summary: When $azoth-dynamic-full-auto is invoked in Codex the network-disabled limitation (Wave A researcher tasks cannot fetch external URLs because network_access = false) is documented only in the Happy path — Codex section of the deep-linked SKILL.md. A user invoking the skill in Codex has no upfront warning at the wrapper level. This creates a discoverability gap: the pipeline will start, discovery waves will be dispatched, and only then will the operator realize Wave A research against external sources is unavailable.
evidence: .agents/skills/azoth-dynamic-full-auto/SKILL.md simply redirects to .claude/commands/dynamic-full-auto.md which redirects to .agents/skills/dynamic-full-auto/SKILL.md. The network_access = false warning is only in SKILL.md under Happy path — Codex (line ~278). .codex/config.toml confirms network_access = false.
recommended_action: Add a short Codex notice near the top of .agents/skills/azoth-dynamic-full-auto/SKILL.md or in the Execution contract block noting that Wave A external research is unavailable in Codex (network disabled) and operators should use pre-seeded context or delegate to a network-enabled platform for that phase.

summary: Auto-router Rule 10 (complexity == medium AND risk == additive, non-known-pattern) selects stage_families [architect-design, plan, execute, quality-gate, closeout] without context-recall. Rules 4 and 5 (instruction-refinement) both mandate context-recall for L2 evidence loading even at the same complexity level. Rule 10 targets novel medium-additive work where unknown memory or recent episode state could influence the architectural decision. Omitting context-recall from this lane is internally consistent if the architect is expected to manually load context, but the SKILL.md rationale does not explain this choice, leaving a potential silent gap for memory-dependent novel work.
evidence: auto-router SKILL.md Rule 10 rationale: 'Medium-complexity additive work where the knowledge dimension is not known-pattern'. Stage families listed: architect-design, plan, execute, quality-gate, closeout — no context-recall. Compare Rules 4/5 which include context-recall. auto.pipeline.yaml Rule 10 stage_families list confirms.
recommended_action: Either add context-recall to Rule 10 stage families (aligning with instruction-refinement lane precedent) or add an explicit rationale note in SKILL.md Rule 10 explaining why context-recall is intentionally omitted for novel medium-additive work (e.g., architect is responsible for loading context inline).
